Ask about astrology learning options

Course availability, instructors, fees and schedules are being confirmed. This page is an enquiry point, not an enrollment or payment page. Contact us for current information before making plans or paying for a programme.

Which topics can I ask about?

Tell us whether you are interested in Vedic astrology, numerology and the Lo Shu grid, or tarot. These are areas of interest for your enquiry, not a confirmed list of available courses. Include whether you are a beginner or already have experience.

What should I check before enrolling?

Ask for the syllabus, instructor background, teaching language, lesson format, session dates, total fees and any required materials. Confirm whether recordings, assignments, feedback or a certificate are included. Request the applicable cancellation and refund terms in writing.

Are courses currently open for enrollment?

Enrollment details are not confirmed on this page. Email support@astrowani.com for the latest information. Mention your preferred topic, language, experience level and availability so the team can respond to your enquiry.

Can I explore the subjects before choosing a course?

Start with our astrology articles and the introductions to kundli reading, numerology and tarot. These explain service topics and can help you decide what you want to study; they are not a substitute for a confirmed syllabus.

Does a course guarantee professional work?

No employment, income or professional certification is promised on this page. If a programme offers a qualification or career support, ask the team to explain exactly what it includes before enrolling.
